cohort: 50 neonates with blood stream infections (BSI) and 50 neonates without BSI.
finding: Low birth weight, premature rupture of membranes, congenital anomalies, exposure to broad spectrum antibiotics and steroids, caesarean section, expressed milk/formula feeding, mechanical ventilation, and delay in enteral feeding were independent risk factors for blood stream infections (BSI).
mod_finding: Caesarean section was an independent risk factor for BSI.
birth_weight: low birth weight (specific values not provided)
